exercises.title: Responsibilities 2 — a right or a responsibility?
exercises.problemHtml:
Each statement comes from either the customer’s Bill of Rights (what the customer can expect from the BA and developers) or the Bill of Responsibilities (what the customer owes the project). Classify.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mỗi phát biểu thuộc Quyền hoặc Trách nhiệm của khách hàng. Phân loại.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Responsibilities 1 — which responsibility is neglected?
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers’ ten customer responsibilities balance the ten rights. Each story shows a customer neglecting one of them. Name it.

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

# Responsibilities 1 — which responsibility is neglected? — answer key

1. Choose the right value for every row.Chọn giá trị đúng cho mỗi dòng.
   - r0.k: 2 Dedicate the time it takes
   - r1.k: 6 Set realistic priorities
   - r2.k: 9 Promptly communicate changes
   - r3.k: 3 Be specific and precise
   - r4.k: 5 Respect cost and feasibility assessments
   - r5.k: 4 Make timely decisions
   - r6.k: 7 Review requirements and evaluate prototypes
   - r7.k: 8 Establish acceptance criteria
   - r8.k: 1 Educate BAs about your business
   Rights without responsibilities do not work: the customer must invest time, precision, decisions and reviews for the BA and developers to deliver what they need.

o.s: The head nurse cancels three workshops in a row: "too busy".
The sponsor marks all 120 requirements as "High".
The client decided a month ago to drop a feature but told nobody.
"Make it fast and nice" — and the customer refuses to say more.
Developers estimate 6 weeks for a feature; the client insists "it is a 2-day job".
A question about the refund rule has waited three weeks for an answer; coding is blocked.
Nobody on the client side opens the prototype the team sent.
The client cannot say how they will decide whether the release is acceptable.
Staff use internal jargon and expect the BA to just know it.

bang.giaiThich: Rights without responsibilities do not work: the customer must invest time, precision, decisions and reviews for the BA and developers to deliver what they need.

Nhầm "đổi ý mà không báo" với "không cụ thể".

exercises.title: Responsibilities 3 — making requirements attainable
exercises.problemHtml:
Responsibility #5: respect developers’ cost and feasibility assessments, and consider rewriting a requirement to make it attainable (e.g. "instantaneously" → "within 50 ms"). Responsibility #3: be specific — TBD markers may flag needed exploration, but must not hide a hard decision nobody will make.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# Responsibilities 3 — making requirements attainable — answer key

1. Developers say "update instantly" is impossible over the hospital network. Best customer response?Dev nói "cập nhật tức thì" không khả thi trên mạng bệnh viện. Khách nên phản hồi thế nào?
   Answer: a) Agree a measurable, attainable target such as "within 2 seconds for 95% of updates"
   Rewrite to make it attainable and verifiable.VI: Viết lại cho khả thi và kiểm được.

2. The SRS has had "Refund policy: TBD" for two months and nobody owns it. This violates…SRS ghi "Chính sách hoàn tiền: TBD" hai tháng, không ai phụ trách. Điều này vi phạm…
   Answer: a) being specific and precise (and making timely decisions)
   TBD must not hide an avoided decision.VI: TBD không được che một quyết định bị né.

3. Why should customers review requirements in small chunks throughout the project?Vì sao khách nên review yêu cầu từng phần nhỏ suốt dự án?
   Answer: b) Early, frequent reviews find defects when they are cheap; a giant tome at the end is rarely reviewed well
   Responsibility #7.VI: Trách nhiệm #7.

exercises.title: Responsibilities 4 — respecting the process
exercises.problemHtml:
Responsibility #10: respect the requirements process. Eliciting and specifying requirements is one of the hardest parts of software; there is a rationale behind the BA’s approach. Responsibility #9: route every change through the project’s change-control process.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.
